major ritual impurity, removed by ghusl

questions.q: Explain the difference between the minimum ghusl and the complete ghusl.
questions.a: Minimum: niyyah and water over the whole body. Complete: following the Prophet's ﷺ way, with wudu first and the head washed three times.

questions.q: Ghusl before the Eid prayer is ...
What is done before pouring water on the head in the complete ghusl?
Write the steps of the complete ghusl as a numbered list on the pupil PDF, marking which part is the minimum needed for validity.
questions.a: Niyyah, Bismillah, hands, private parts, wudu, head three times, whole body right then left; minimum: niyyah and water over the whole body

questions.q: Extend: why is ghusl before Jumu'ah encouraged?
questions.a: Jumu'ah is a gathering; Muslims come clean and fresh.

questions.q: Stretch: why does Islam treat this topic plainly, without embarrassment?
questions.a: Worship needs knowledge; the Companions asked such questions openly and respectfully.

questions.q: Which ghusl is sunnah, not obligatory?
questions.a: A) Before Jumu'ah. Ghusl for Jumu'ah is a strong sunnah; the others are obligatory.

questions.q: Think again: why a full wash sometimes and wudu other times?
questions.a: Major impurity needs ghusl; minor impurity needs wudu.
